title: Measures at Foreign Worker Dormitories after Circuit Breaker Period
what_it_is: Measures at Foreign Worker Dormitories after Circuit Breaker Period

sections.label: LOA replaced by Stay-Home Notices
sections.summary: From 19 February, LOA was ceased and replaced with Stay-Home Notices.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: From 19 February, LOA was ceased and replaced with Stay-Home Notices (SHN).

sections.label: Dormitory housing and SHN facilities
sections.summary: Dormitory operators had to house LOA or SHN residents separately, and SHNs must now be served at dedicated facilities.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Dormitory operators were required to house their residents under LOA or SHN, together with others on LOA or SHN, in a section of the dormitory that is separate from other residents, or in dedicated rooms.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Given the widespread transmission of COVID-19 in many countries, SHNs must now be served at dedicated facilities.

sections.label: MOM dormitory isolation inspections
sections.summary: Since 29 January 2020, MOM informed licensed dormitories to set aside isolation facilities and inspected compliance.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Since 29 January 2020, MOM had proactively informed all dormitories licensed under the Foreign Employee Dormitories Act to set aside isolation facilities and conducted inspections to ensure compliance.

sections.label: ITF moves workers to temporary accommodation
sections.summary: The ITF shifted about 32,000 healthy workers from dormitories to Government-provided temporary accommodation.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: To further control the transmission in the dormitories, the Inter-Agency Task Force (ITF) shifted about 32,000 healthy workers from the dormitories to Government-provided temporary accommodation, such as sports halls, vacant HDB blocks, army camps, floating hotels and private apartments slated for redevelopment.

sections.label: More temporary housing to reduce density
sections.summary: In the medium term, the Government will build more temporary housing to reduce density in existing dormitories.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: In the medium term, the Government will continue to build up more temporary housing accommodations to reduce the density in the existing dormitories.

sections.label: Migrant worker COVID-19 recovery status
sections.summary: Of about 30,000 dormitory migrant workers confirmed positive, about half recovered and most of the rest are recovering well.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: As of end of May, out of the 30,000 or so migrant workers residing in dormitories confirmed positive for COVID-19, about half have recovered and, of the remaining half, the vast majority are recovering well with only one requiring intensive hospital care.
